text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with aggressive behavior, altered mental status, and autonomic dysregulation. To begin our assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and did anything specific trigger them?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior. They mention that he has been under significant stress due to final exams and has become more reclusive. Earlier this evening, he exhibited extreme irritability, yelled at his computer, broke it, and then spent several hours at the gym.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Serotonin Syndrome. The history of gym exercise (likely intense weightlifting) combined with high-stress exam periods and new aggressive behavior suggests a potential interaction between stimulant use, exercise-induced stress, or a serotonergic agent, leading to the triad of neuromuscular hyperactivity, altered mental status, and autonomic instability. Please confirm if you are currently taking any antidepressants, stimulants, or have had recent changes in medication.
